name: file-explorer
description: Browse and read files on the machine running the host without leaving the dashboard. Keep several files open in tabs, walk the directory tree with each file's git status beside it, search a whole folder for a string, and read markdown rendered rather than raw. It is read-only by design: it opens and searches files but never edits, moves, or deletes them, and it can only reach your home directory plus /tmp and /opt — symlinks out are refused.
author: kirocrew
